data.summary: A required gate recorded partial (e.g. unit_tests ran only the selected files) can never satisfy ddflow complete: complete demands unit_tests=passed and the only override is --force, which the forbidden-commands hook blocks. Under [ci].tests_scope=selected and the rule that agents never run the whole suite, every item whose selected run is honestly partial ends merged-but-not-completed (seen: fix-B1bfcaf6ebb, fix-Be305b7d6ea, fix-B-roborev-branch-arch-guards, 2026-10-19). Needs: a covered-by-merge-queue/full-run outcome that complete accepts, or a recorded post-merge full-suite pass that settles partial gates.
data.title: complete refuses partial required gates with no legitimate settle path

data.body:
Fixes bug Bb999d5e20f: A required gate recorded partial (e.g. unit_tests ran only the selected files) can never satisfy ddflow complete: complete demands unit_tests=passed and the only override is --force, which the forbidden-commands hook blocks. Under [ci].tests_scope=selected and the rule that agents never run the whole suite, every item whose selected run is honestly partial ends merged-but-not-completed (seen: fix-B1bfcaf6ebb, fix-Be305b7d6ea, fix-B-roborev-branch-arch-guards, 2026-10-19). Needs: a covered-by-merge-queue/full-run outcome that complete accepts, or a recorded post-merge full-suite pass that settles partial gates.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bb999d5e20f --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bb999d5e20f --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug Bb999d5e20f: complete refuses partial required gates with no legitimate settle path
